### 💼 Professional Experience

**Full Stack Software Engineer** · *Mobii Digital Inc.* · Contract, Remote · Feb 2026 – Present
- Built the **multi-agent system** behind **[Gondoor](https://gondoor.app)**, an AI platform that helps users launch and run a business from a chat (TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, OpenAI + Claude via Vercel AI SDK and Claude Agent SDK)
  - **CEO Agent** — orchestrator the user chats with; routes tasks to specialist agents via tool calling and runs a Council of founder-persona agents that critiques the user's idea
  - **Engineering Agent** — turns a request into code changes for web apps, SaaS and e-commerce sites, runs them in isolated sandboxes and pushes them to GitHub; load-tested to **100 concurrent users**
